reaction: Different ending to the phone: the promise I broke is named, and the private page staying private is named. So choices really do change the last paragraph. Good, but it is over in a minute.
Game ended in about 75 seconds. Both endings named my choices, but I only ever pick one of two.

Stopping the laptop. Nicer than the phone, and failing the visit was honest and told me why. But it is one short pass of two-button choices and I have seen what changes. I would not come back for the same three days.
